source_name: BQK — Sistemet e Pagesave / Operating scheme of the Interbank Payment System (KIPS) pages
why_relevant: Describes KIPS operating rules: clearing sessions, value thresholds (real-time above EUR 10,000), participant list and the four-phase accession process for new participants. Primary reference for interbank clearing mechanics and for tracking who joins the system.

source_name: BQK — Strategjia Kombëtare për Pagesat me Vlera të Vogla (National Retail Payments Strategy)
why_relevant: The strategy (2021-2026, World Bank/SECO-supported) sets the roadmap and deadlines for instant payments, interoperability, QR standardisation and SEPA readiness. A successor strategy is likely due, making this the single best forward-looking deadline document for the cell.

source_name: Ligji Nr. 04/L-155 për Sistemin e Pagesave (Law on the Payment System)
why_relevant: The enabling statute under which all CBK payment regulations are issued; every regulation cites it in its preamble. Needed as the baseline against which the new Law on Payment Services (2026) supersedes/amends provisions.

source_name: Projektligji për Shërbimet e Pagesave (Draft Law on Payment Services) — Office of the Prime Minister
why_relevant: The PSD2-transposing draft law (Government Decision No. 08/08, 3 April 2026) introducing open banking, TPP access and the modern PI/EMI regime. Its entry into force is an explicit precondition for Kosovo's final SEPA application. An earlier 2024 version also exists, enabling version-diffing of the policy trajectory.

source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — draft-law tracker (projektligjet)
why_relevant: Parliamentary tracker giving procedural status, committee reports, amendments and voting dates for payments legislation. This is where the legislative deadline signal (first/second reading, adoption) becomes observable before publication in the Official Gazette.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për IBAN / Sistemi i Numrave Standardë të Llogarive Bankare
why_relevant: Defines the Kosovo IBAN/BAN standard — a hard technical prerequisite for SEPA scheme participation and for any cross-border payment routing work. Version history shows the standard being reissued as SEPA alignment progresses.

source_name: BQK — KOS-GIRO standard document / QR code standardisation guideline
why_relevant: KOS-GIRO is the national bill-payment slip standard; CBK has separately approved a Guideline (Udhëzim) standardising the payment QR code aligned to the EPC QR standard. Together these are the domestic payment-standards layer feeding merchant/POS and bill-payment interoperability.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për Instrumentet e Pagesave Elektronike
why_relevant: Rule governing issuance of electronic payment instruments (cards, e-wallets) and the requirement to be licensed by CBK before offering them — directly relevant to card scheme, POS and acquiring market entry conditions.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (licensed institutions register)
why_relevant: Periodically re-issued register listing licensed entities and their permitted activities including 'Shërbime të Pagesave' and 'Emetim i Parasë Elektronike'. It is the observable output of the licensing regime — new PI/EMI entrants appear here first.

source_name: BQK — Newsroom / press releases (sq, sr, en)
why_relevant: CBK announces regulation approvals, SEPA milestones (pre-application submitted 14 Oct 2024, updated 20 Dec 2024), board meeting outcomes and instant-payment initiatives here before the documents appear in the legal framework index. Fastest deadline signal in the cell; published in all three languages.

source_name: BQK — Serbian-language regulation series (?lang=sr PDFs)
why_relevant: Confirms CBK publishes the payments regulation package in Serbian ('SRB-n.' file prefix, e.g. the funds-transfer information / travel-rule regulation). Necessary for Serbian-language coverage and for reaching institutions serving Serb-majority municipalities.

source_name: European Payments Council — SEPA geographical scope criteria and EPC List of SEPA Scheme Countries
why_relevant: The counterparty side of the accession: EPC publishes the versioned list (EPC409-09, v8.0 Dec 2025) and the criteria for extending the geographical scope to non-EEA jurisdictions. Kosovo's inclusion will be evidenced here first, with a dated version bump.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës)
why_relevant: Industry body co-hosting CBK workshops on instant-payment infrastructure (May 2026) and representing the participant community that must implement scheme migrations. Reveals implementation timelines and bank-side readiness that regulators do not publish.

source_name: German Economic Team — Kosovo SEPA accession analysis
why_relevant: Donor-funded advisory that explains the SEPA accession procedure step by step (legislation -> CBK application -> EPC/DG FISMA assessment -> PSP scheme adherence) and dates the regulatory milestones. Useful as a pointer to the specific laws and regulations required.

source_name: BQK Annual Report / Godišnji izveštaj (payment systems chapter)
why_relevant: Annual reports contain a dedicated payment-systems section: KIPS volumes/values, oversight activity, regulations approved during the year, and stated priorities for the coming year (open banking, crypto licensing, cyber). Good retrospective ground truth and forward priority list, published in sq/sr/en.

source_name: Kosovo financial/economic press as regulatory early-warning (Radio Evropa e Lirë, Telegrafi, Buletini Ekonomik, Arbresh)
why_relevant: Albanian-language media surfaced facts not on the CBK site: three payments-related laws stalled at the Constitutional Court blocking the final SEPA application, and CBK's approval of the QR-code standardisation guideline. Serves as a tripwire pointing back to primary documents.

source_name: Gjykata Kushtetuese e Kosovës (Constitutional Court) — case docket
why_relevant: Multiple sources report that three laws required for the SEPA application are pending before the Constitutional Court, making the Court's docket a hard dependency for the payments-regulation timeline. Judgments and referral registrations are published in sq/sr/en.

source_name: RPHS Law – News Room (Prishtina)
why_relevant: Kosovo full-service firm with a genuinely active banking/finance legal-alert feed; observed posts on the new Law on Banks entering into force, the crypto-asset service operator licensing regulation, and a SEPA legislative-milestones piece. Highest-signal Kosovo law-firm channel found for banking and payments rule changes with dates.

source_name: PwC Kosovo – Tax Alerts / Tax News
why_relevant: Dedicated Kosovo-country PwC alert page describing itself as periodic publications on proposed major changes to tax laws and regulations. Primary channel for fiscalization / EDI / VAT and tax-procedure deadlines that bind payment-accepting merchants and banks.

source_name: Deloitte Albania & Kosova – Tax & Legal Alerts
why_relevant: Deloitte Kosova sh.p.k. publishes Kosovo-specific Tax & Legal Alerts through the Albania/Kosova hub; search evidence shows coverage of the CBK Regulation on Electronic Payment Instruments and of Fiscal Package 2.0 — exactly the payments+fiscalization intersection of this cell.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters – Kosovo section and Legal Briefings
why_relevant: Aggregates law-firm-authored briefings on Kosovo, including an explicit 'Kosovo: New Banking Law Comes into Force with Further Reforms Ahead' briefing and 'The Banking and Finance Legal Framework and the Way Ahead'. Best single pointer for discovering which Kosovo/regional firms are actually writing on banking, and for annual market-overview interviews naming the legislative pipeline.

source_name: Lexology – Kosovo financial-services law firm articles
why_relevant: Syndication platform where regional firms post Kosovo alerts; a concrete example surfaced covering Draft Law No. 08/L-295 on Crypto-Assets. Useful because it timestamps firm commentary on DRAFT laws — i.e. the consultation stage, before adoption.

source_name: Rule and Law – Kosovo regulatory/licensing news & blogs
why_relevant: Consultancy/legal-advisory blog publishing operational, deadline-oriented explainers on CBK licensing (crypto-asset service provider licence: CBK requirements, process and timeline). This is the 'compliance checklist' genre the cell targets, and it covers CBK authorisation procedure that regulators describe only in legal prose.

source_name: Vokshi & Lata Law Firm – publications and Legal Guide to Investing in Kosovo
why_relevant: Prishtina full-service firm advising financial institutions; publishes a multilingual Legal Guide to Investing in Kosovo (EN/FR/DE) with a regulatory chapter, and its partner is quoted forecasting 170+ laws planned for 2026 — a useful pipeline signal for the legislative calendar.

source_name: Sejdiu & Qerkini LLC (SQ Law) – Prishtina
why_relevant: One of the leading Kosovo corporate firms, regularly quoted on Kosovo legal-system developments (Commercial Court, regulatory reform). Likely publisher of client updates; a candidate to monitor for banking/AML commentary.

source_name: Boga & Associates – Albania/Kosovo legal updates
why_relevant: Regional firm explicitly advising banks and financial institutions in Kosovo as well as Albania; its banking & finance practice is a plausible publisher of cross-border legal updates covering Kosovo banking/AML rules. Domain inferred from firm name — treat as unverified until a fetch confirms.

source_name: Kalo & Associates – Kosovo office publications
why_relevant: Albania-founded full-service firm operating in Kosovo since 2008 with a Banking & Finance practice; regional firms of this type publish periodic legal newsletters covering both jurisdictions. Domain inferred — verify.
